name: What types of materials are available for deck board replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of materials are available for deck board replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for deck board replacement include pressure-treated lumber, cedar, redwood, and composite decking. Pressure-treated lumber is durable and cost-effective. Cedar and redwood offer natural resistance to rot and insects, providing a premium aesthetic. Composite decking, made from a mix of wood fibers and plastic, requires less maintenance and often comes with longer warranties. The best choice depends on your budget, desired aesthetics, maintenance preferences, and the existing deck structure's compatibility with the new material's weight and fastening requirements.
